note: v0.11.22: what tools/leftovers.mjs reports but stays on purpose, with a reason each. "name*" matches a prefix. Kinds: files, functions, testOnly, css, flagsUnread, flagsUnset, items, storage, markers, choices. New entries only with the owner's ok.

files.project/*: the project docs (named only in other docs, which the file scan skips)
files.CLAUDE.md: the hard rules, read by Claude at the start of a chat
files..github/*: GitHub runs the workflows by itself
files.saves/*: tests/saves.test.mjs loads every file in the folder
files.tools/bg.py: by hand: makes the background crops in art/bg (handover, Files)
files.tools/snap.mjs: by hand: fresh test saves for each new save format (tests/README.md)

testOnly.setDryClone: test hook: the lean = full copy comparison in tests/tasks.test.mjs
testOnly.START_SCENE: the first scene, exported for the tests
testOnly.taskState: test accessor: tests/tasks.test.mjs reads familiarity and the queue through it

choices.meridians#0: Incremental Mode runs the meridian work as Meditate cards (js/core/meditate.js), never as a choice on the screen
